Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds.

Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:

  • Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. 
  • Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações.
  • Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer.
  • Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade.
  • Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa.
  • 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. 
  • Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.

O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?

A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes.

  • Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado.
  • Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL).
  • Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos).
  • Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança.
  • Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.

O que esperamos de você?

Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica.
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura.
  • Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.

Quais são os requisitos?

  • Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção 
  • Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem;
  • Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
  • Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);
  • Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.

O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);

  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;

  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:

We are seeking a Customer Service / Sales Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our clients, partners, and internal teams. Your primary responsibility will be to help users throughout their experience on our platform, ensuring they can communicate smoothly and receive exceptional service. 


Responsibilities:  

  • Provide frontline support to clients during account registration, identity verification, deposits, withdrawals, and general platform use. 
  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat, email, and phone with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. 
  • Monitor and resolve issues related to account access, transactions, and platform functionality, escalating when necessary. 
  • Collaborate with the sales and operations teams to ensure timely follow-up and a seamless customer experience. 
  • Maintain accurate client and partner information in CRM systems. 
  • Support service campaigns focused on client satisfaction, retention, and community engagement. 
  • Track common questions and issues to help improve internal processes and FAQs. 

Qualifications:  

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service or sales support roles. 
  • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). 
  • Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented when dealing with customers. 
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce). 
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in fintech, digital platforms, or affiliate programs is a plus. 

What We Offer:  

  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities

title: Business Development Representative (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative (Remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.


O que você vai fazer aqui?


  • Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e , gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos.
  • Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença.
  • Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.


O que buscamos?


  • Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real.
  • Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente.
  • Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico.
  • Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar.
  • Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.


Pontos extra se...


  • Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market.
  • Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como HubSpot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.).
  • Fala espanhol.


O que oferecemos?

  • Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta.
  • Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva.
  • Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

title: English Teacher
description:

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

  • Portuguese as a first language.

  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring.
  • Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews.
  • Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.

  • 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior.
  • Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns.
  • Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical.
  • Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms.
  • Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role).
  • Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.

    • Our Backend Stack

    TypeScript · Node.js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, , TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

About you:

This is a direct-hire, high-impact position designed for a support professional who views every interaction as an opportunity to build a relationship. As a Customer Support Specialist, you are the primary face and voice of Smarter Contact across our multiple support channels.


Your mission is to deliver best-in-class customer support while building trust and creating a seamless customer experience. You are not just closing tickets, you are solving complex SMS delivery issues, guiding customers through compliance requirements, and ensuring every interaction is handled with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism while maintaining strong customer satisfaction.

What You’ll Own:

  • Provide high-quality assistance through real-time chat, emails and phone calls, ensuring a seamless experience across all channels.
  • Consistently maintain a CSAT score of over 85% while meeting targets for response times and resolution speed.
  • Achieve monthly revenue quotas by identifying and closing plan upgrades during customer interactions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chats, calls, and tasks within the CRM to ensure team-wide visibility.
  • Identify early warning signs like frustration or delivery issues during live chats and resolve them to protect account health.
  • Reinforce the Smarter Contact value proposition and competitive edge in every customer conversation.
  • Capture and relay frontline insights regarding bugs, UX friction, and feature requests to the Product and Leadership teams.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 8 AM - 8 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

Especialista em infraestrutura Sênior

• Arquitetura de conta do Azure Storage e considerações de design;

• Serviços de storage: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue e Table Storage;

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS);

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering;

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking;

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher;

• Métricas de throughput, latência, disponibilidade e erros;

• Monitoramento de storage accounts, file shares e recursos de rede

Logs e Analytics;

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura;

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais;


**Backup, Recuperação e Resiliência**

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files;

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault;

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restore;

• Retenção de dados e requisitos de conformidade;

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Consultor de Vendas-Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Vendas-Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo demandas de infraestrutura, indústria, hotelaria, varejo, facilities comerciais e compras baseadas em projetos.

Diferente das plataformas tradicionais focadas apenas na venda de produtos, a SolutionMall concentra-se na entrega estruturada de soluções , incluindo:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos do cliente
  • Seleção de produtos adequados
  • Correspondência entre demanda e solução
  • Coordenação com fornecedores
  • Suporte em cotações
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades e projetos

Na área de soluções para eletrodomésticos comerciais , a SolutionMall atende uma ampla gama de produtos e sistemas utilizados em hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e instalações públicas.

Nossa cobertura de soluções pode incluir:

  • Máquinas de lavar e secadoras comerciais
  • Equipamentos para lavanderias self-service
  • Refrigeradores comerciais e expositores refrigerados
  • Equipamentos de refrigeração para supermercados
  • Expositores de bebidas
  • Displays comerciais e sinalização digital
  • Aquecedores de água para hotéis e aplicações comerciais
  • Lava-louças comerciais e equipamentos de limpeza
  • Equipamentos para cozinhas industriais
  • Ar-condicionado comercial e sistemas de ventilação
  • Sistemas de exaustão para cozinhas
  • Sistemas de renovação de ar
  • Pias, áreas de lavagem, bancadas e equipamentos auxiliares em aço inoxidável
  • Pacotes integrados de eletrodomésticos comerciais para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias e facilities

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios da SolutionMall no Brasil.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que possuam recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos seguintes setores:

  • Eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Equipamentos para hotéis
  • Equipamentos para restaurantes
  • Equipamentos para supermercados
  • Equipamentos de lavanderia
  • HVAC
  • Cozinhas industriais
  • Refrigeração comercial
  • Fornecimento de equipamentos para facilities
  • Distribuição B2B de equipamentos

O foco principal da função é desenvolver oportunidades locais, identificar demandas reais de compra, apoiar o desenvolvimento de RFQs e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções comerciais no mercado brasileiro.

Temos interesse especial em candidatos que compreendam a diferença entre equipamentos de uso comercial e eletrodomésticos residenciais comuns .

O candidato ideal deverá apoiar atividades como:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Comunicação com canais e distribuidores
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • Coordenação de RFQs e cotações
  • Promoção de soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Coleta de feedback do mercado local
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Esta não é uma função de venda no varejo de eletrodomésticos residenciais. Trata-se de uma função de desenvolvimento de negócios B2B , focada em equipamentos comerciais, projetos e aplicações de uso contínuo e profissional.

3) Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver oportunidades locais de clientes e canais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e projetos de facilities.
  • Promover soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais, como equipamentos de lavanderia, refrigeração, cozinhas industriais, lava-louças, aquecedores de água, displays, HVAC, exaustão e sistemas de ventilação.
  • Acompanhar necessidades dos clientes, RFQs, cotações, seleção de produtos e progresso dos projetos.
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipe da SolutionMall, fornecedores, distribuidores e contatos de projeto.
  • Compartilhar feedback do mercado brasileiro sobre tendências de demanda, preços, concorrentes, hábitos de compra e oportunidades de canais.

4) Qualificações

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em eletrodomésticos comerciais, equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, refrigeração, lavanderia comercial, cozinhas industriais, HVAC, ventilação ou vendas B2B de equipamentos.
  • Familiaridade com equipamentos de uso comercial e capacidade de compreender necessidades dos clientes, seleção de produtos, acompanhamento de RFQs e coordenação de cotações.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e habilidade para desenvolver clientes locais, distribuidores, empreiteiros, integradores ou contatos de projeto no Brasil.
  • Experiência com hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, empresas de facilities ou distribuidores de equipamentos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Recursos existentes de clientes ou canais no Brasil serão uma forte vantagem.
  • Inglês profissional para comunicação de negócios será considerado um diferencial.
  • Português fluente é necessário para comunicação local no Brasil.

5) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios.

As principais áreas de atuação incluem:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações
  • Comunicação sobre produtos e soluções
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso dos projetos e contribuição comercial real.

6) Benefícios da Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e à contribuição comercial real, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Avanço de RFQs
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Progresso de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios

Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional e contribuição para projetos.

7) Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo ou envie seu currículo para:

Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais – Brasil

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.

  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes.   • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.

title: Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.
  • Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage.
  • Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications.
  • Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability.
  • Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
  • Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience.
  • Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance.


Whom Are We looking For

We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You’ll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value.


Key Qualifications

  • Node.js, TypeScript & React Expertise: Extensive experience with NodeJS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies.
  • TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code.
  • Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand.
  • Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health.
  • Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release.
  • Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus.
  • Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team.
  • Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity.


Bonus Qualifications

  • Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads.
  • AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions.
  • Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus.
  • Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

We run two core programs: College Planning (Grades 9–11) and College Essay (senior year). Both are high-touch, deadline-driven, and built on the belief that every student and family deserves a consistent, exceptional experience.

You'll report to the CEO and work closely with our Operations Specialist — the person who will use the systems you build every day.

  • Airtable (required) — tables, views, relationships, automations
  • Zapier and/or n8n (required) — connecting tools, automating workflows
  • Google Workspace (required)
  • AI fluent — you stay current on no-code AI tools and know how to apply them to real problems

  • Create visibility into student progress — so we always know who's on track and who needs attention
  • Automate workflows — so the team spends less time on manual updates
  • Set up tools that make coaches' jobs easier

First Projects

  • Build a system that tracks student progress and flags issues automatically
  • Set up an internal chatbot so coaches can self-serve answers
  • Create a searchable archive of past work to speed up prep


Who You Are

  • Builder first. You take a messy problem and build a working system from scratch.
  • Precise. Small mistakes compound — you catch them before they do.
  • Resourceful. You figure things out without waiting for direction.
  • Clear communicator. You can explain what you built and why.

Nice to Have

Benefits

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:


• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

• Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.

• Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
